cuts.label: scout:jynxzi/jynxzi-about-head-2026w38
cuts.title: Jynxzi Offers $100,000 To Alveus Sanctuary
cuts.retelling: Streamer Jynxzi finishes a day at an animal sanctuary where his viewers raised $1,000, then surprises the worker by announcing he wants to donate $100,000 himself, and she is stunned.

cuts.label: scout:harmless+jerma985+pokelawls/harmless-jerma985-pokelawls-bike-charact-2026w41
cuts.title: Jerma tries to fuel a bike in GTA RP and it explodes
cuts.hook: Jerma tries to fuel a bike
cuts.retelling: Jerma bumbles through fueling a bike while shouting for Donnie, the bike catches fire, and Pokelawls's stream reveals it was his bike and he panics.

cuts.label: caseoh@vod2894828714/caseoh-caseoh-command-2026w41
cuts.title: CaseOh teaches his AI sister to drive and it goes badly
cuts.hook: CaseOh's AI sister Halima learns to drive
cuts.retelling: CaseOh tries to teach his in-game AI sister Halima to drive, but she does the opposite of whatever he says: she speeds up when he says slow and slows down when he says fast. They crash, and he asks why she never listens.

cuts.label: kaicenat@vod2822355279/kaicenat-main-office-2026w29
cuts.title: Kai Cenat plays principal and kicks a student out for almost ruining picture day
cuts.hook: Kai plays principal and calls everyone in
cuts.retelling: Kai, playing a strict school principal, grills a student in his office about who she's 'stitching' on, then kicks her out for almost spilling something on his picture-day clothes and celebrates saving his pants.

cuts.label: buddha@vod2874084975/buddha-brickboi-charact-2026w38
cuts.title: Buddha signs an artist to his record label in NoPixel
cuts.hook: Buddha signs an artist to his label
cuts.retelling: In a NoPixel roleplay, Buddha's bluffing record boss welcomes a signing he can't remember, brags that he's poached the artist's lawyer, learns she works for another label, then rushes the staff to applaud the artist out the door.

cuts.label: joebartolozzi@vod2875866566/joebartolozzi-about-arriv-2026w38
cuts.title: Joe Bartolozzi's laundromat job is a cover for something much worse
cuts.retelling: Joe plays a laundromat horror game, a customer picks up laundry that turns out to be murder supplies, and later he's jailed and told the laundry is a cover for moving people into the game's world.

cuts.label: scout:harmless+jerma985/harmless-jerma985-bike-jerma-2026w41
cuts.title: Harmless baited Jerma into crashing his bike
cuts.hook: Harmless baits Jerma into pressing F
cuts.retelling: Harmless talks Jerma into pressing F while riding a motorcycle in GTA, Jerma does it and wipes out, and Harmless says he fell for the oldest trick.
